shellCommands.command: find app lib __agent_eval__ -type f | head -50 && echo "--- next.config ---" && cat next.config.ts
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference && ls functions | grep -iE 'revalidate|update|cachetag|cachelife' && echo "=== revalidateTag ===" && cat functions/revalidateTag.md

cd /workspace && echo "=== app/page.tsx ===" && cat app/page.tsx && echo "=== app/layout.tsx ===" && cat app/layout.tsx && echo "=== lib/db.js ===" && cat lib/db.js && echo "=== eval run.mjs ===" && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives && grep -nE 'deprecat|Server Action|inline|cacheLife|runtime caching|warning|cannot|must not' use-cache.md | head -40
cd /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/01-directives && sed -n '195,245p' use-cache.md && echo "..... 515-535 ....." && sed -n '510,540p' use-cache.md

(npx next start -p 3111 >/tmp/start.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 6 && for i in 1 2 3; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "req$i total=%{time_total}s http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/; done && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ | grep -oE 'Sync latest catalog|Headphones|<form action="[^"]*"' | head

cd /tmp && curl -s http://localhost:3111/ > p.html && grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' p.html | head -2; AID=$(grep -oE '\$ACTION_ID_[a-f0-9]+' p.html | head -1); echo "action id: $AID"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "POST total=%{time_total}s http=%{http_code}\n" -X POST http://localhost:3111/ -F "$AID=" ; for i in 1 2; do curl -s -o /dev/null -w "after-sync req$i total=%{time_total}s http=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3111/; done
